prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and underpredicted (+13.3% vs +12.0%), but moving it to hand-off showed no clear effect and moving it after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%).
Home redesigns like interactive waiting rooms were helpful (+5.6%), though predictions were too high (+8.0%).
Adoption incentives were helpful (+7.6%), but predictions were overestimated (+10.0%).
Path selection headline copy updates were helpful and underpredicted (+5.9% vs +1.0%), though general path copy simplification showed no clear effect.
Compact grid layouts for friend selection in adoption performed worse (-7.7%).
Live 3D render progress trackers and sound notifications showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, incentive: +7.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: -7.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.0% over 2 test(s)
- finish, notification: +3.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +2.2% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: +5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.8% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Photo Upload Quality Assistant: Redesign the photo upload screen into a two-column layout featuring live image validation checks alongside sample acceptable pet photos. (why: Support mail received 3 bug reports about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low at 63.0%.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough: Add a dedicated controls walkthrough screen before the final welcome screen showing visual instructions for interacting with, hiding, and summoning the desktop pet. (why: Support received 3 emails post-onboarding asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish completion drops to 70.1%.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Device Account Sync Banner: Display an explicit account synchronization notice on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in preserves existing pet data. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Readiness Status Checklist: Display a detailed system initialization checklist on the waiting screen showing asset rendering and desktop spawn status. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop or app stall, while waiting step mean time takes 2336s.)
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Mascot Welcome Greeting Stage: Redesign the finish screen into a stage layout showcasing an animated mascot welcoming the user to their desktop. (why: The finish step conversion drops to 70.1% with a mean duration of 5815s.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Name Badge Banner: Add an official adoption badge and name tag confirmation to the certificate screen before final sign-in. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the onboarding funnel (63.0%), and adoption incentives previously proved successful (+7.6%).)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Time Expectation Banner: Add a hint banner on the path selection screen explaining the difference in setup duration between premade and custom pet paths. (why: choose_path has a huge disparity between median time (8s) and mean time (514s), showing some users get stuck trying to decide.)
7: [home, notification] System Tray Desktop Spawn Alert Prompt: Configure a notification tip on the waiting screen pointing out exactly where on the desktop taskbar/tray the pet will spawn. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on the desktop or users unable to locate the open app.)

Targets 70.1% finish drop-off, but full redesign is high cost without direct support mail evidence.
Targets worst drop-off step (63.0%) using proven adoption incentive mechanics (+7.6%).
